ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
This module provides a way for securely storing passwords and other secrets.
It uses D-Bus Secret Service API that is supported by GNOME Keyring (since
version 2.30) and KSecretsService.
The main classes provided are secretstorage.Item, representing a secret item
(that has a label, a secret and some attributes) and secretstorage.Collection,
a place items are stored in.
SecretStorage supports most of the functions provided by Secret Service,
including creating and deleting items and collections, editing items, locking
and unlocking collections (asynchronous unlocking is also supported).
about.summary: Provides a way for securely storing passwords and other secrets.

name: secretstorage
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "3.5.0"
  python_check_max: "3.14"

package:
  name: secretstorage
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/S/SecretStorage/secretstorage-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f04b8e4689cbce351744d5537bf6b1329c6fc68f91fa666f60a380edddcd11be

build:
  number: 3
  noarch: python
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --check-build-dependencies --disable-pip-version-check

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77.0
  run:
    - __linux
    - cryptography >=2.0
    - dbus
    - jeepney >=0.6
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports: secretstorage
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - ${{ python_check_max }}.*

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Provides a way for securely storing passwords and other secrets.
  description: |
    This module provides a way for securely storing passwords and other secrets.
    It uses D-Bus Secret Service API that is supported by GNOME Keyring (since
    version 2.30) and KSecretsService.
    The main classes provided are secretstorage.Item, representing a secret item
    (that has a label, a secret and some attributes) and secretstorage.Collection,
    a place items are stored in.
    SecretStorage supports most of the functions provided by Secret Service,
    including creating and deleting items and collections, editing items, locking
    and unlocking collections (asynchronous unlocking is also supported).
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project//secretstorage
  repository: https://github.com/mitya57/secretstorage
  documentation: https://secretstorage.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - CurtLH
    - ccordoba12
